prompt: A trip is $300$ miles long. Your average speed in miles per hour is $s(t) = \frac{300}{t}$, where $t$ is the number of hours the trip takes. If the trip takes $5$ hours, what is your average speed?
explanation: Speed is distance divided by time.

alternativeExplanations.title: Split the trip into hours
steps: Five equal hours must share the 300 miles.
Each hour carries the same chunk of road.
$300$ miles $\div$ 5 chunks $= 60$ miles in each hour.
